outliers.video_title: I Was Told 12 Weeks. It Took Me 9 Months. (Rotator Cuff Truth)
outliers.why_it_worked: The title contradicts the standard '12 week' recovery number every surgeon quotes, which is the exact number every viewer googled the night before surgery. It reads as a warning, not a complaint, so it doesn't feel like clickbait.
outliers.rewritten_title: They Said 12 Weeks. My Rotator Cuff Took 9 Months.
outliers.rewritten_hook: Open on the surgeon's discharge paperwork with '12 weeks' circled, then cut to a calendar with 9 months crossed off. Say the number out loud before any b-roll of exercises.

outliers.video_title: Sleeping After Shoulder Surgery Ruined My Recovery (Do This Instead)
outliers.why_it_worked: Sleep is the one part of recovery nobody warns you about, and 'ruined my recovery' implies a mistake the viewer might already be making tonight. It's the highest-urgency angle in the niche because it applies every single night, not just during PT sessions.
outliers.rewritten_title: How I Was Sleeping Wrong After Rotator Cuff Surgery (Nobody Told Me)
outliers.rewritten_hook: Show the recliner-versus-bed setup in the first 3 seconds, then say the pillow angle mistake before explaining why.

outliers.video_title: 6 Months Post-Op Rotator Cuff: What My MRI Actually Showed
outliers.why_it_worked: MRI footage is proof nobody else shows. Most channels talk about pain and range of motion; this one has an imaging result on screen, which reads as credible in a niche full of unverifiable pain claims.
outliers.rewritten_title: 6 Months Post-Op: My MRI Results (Full Tear vs. Repair)
outliers.rewritten_hook: Cut straight to the MRI viewer on screen before any talking-head intro. Circle the repair site with a red marker on frame one.
